title: [ingest] Tasks blocked on cross-workspace ghost deps back off to maxPoll, not stop
summary: When the only ready-blocker is an unresolved ghost: dependency, decideOne returns action 'idle' at maxPoll (1200s) — it waits for the foreign provider instead of stopping the loop, so a cross-workspace dependency never looks like a drained DAG.
